calibrate_probe_high.docs: The pH probe have to be calibrated. For this you need to know the pH reference value of the calibration high solution.

calibrate_probe_low.docs: The pH probe have to be calibrated. For this you need to know the pH reference value of the calibration low solution.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the ufire pH sensor.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#in-some-trigger)*

reset.docs: Reset the current calibration on the sensor.

address.docs:
**int**: Specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x3f`.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this sensor for use in lambdas.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

ph.docs:
**[Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor)**: Set the pH sensor configuration. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
**[Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor)**: Set the onboard temperature sensor configuration. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor). Can't be used together with `temperature_sensor`.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

temperature_sensor.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of the temperature sensor. Only needed if the onboard temperature sensor is not used.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the ufire pH sensor.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#in-some-trigger)*

solution.docs:
**float**: Solution reference pH value.

*See also: [uFire ISE pH sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ufire_ise#in-some-trigger)*
